title: Bohr Inequality for Integral Operators on K-Quasiconformal Harmonic Mappings
content:
Bohr-type inequalities have been extensively studied for integral operators defined on 2
bounded analytic functions in the unit disk. In this paper, we extend this line of inves- 3
tigation to the class of K-quasiconformal harmonic mappings and consider the action of 4
integral operators (including the Bernardi and Cesàro operators) on the harmonic mappings 5
whose analytic parts are bounded in modulus by one. Our results provide estimates that 6
generalize existing results in the analytic case.
